If the runner group admits public repositories and fork-PR workflows need no approval, an outsider's fork PR can run there. Must be closed before the App gains more permissions.

owner_decisions_queued.topic: GitHub App actions:read + contents:read on selected repos
owner_decisions_queued.detail: Needed for the host's per-job cache trust-class lookups, installed only on the aap-crrr runner group's repositories. Cost: a stolen App key could also read run logs, artifacts and source of those repos. Gates P02.3 and cache sharing; Q1 is a precondition.
A hostile guest that keeps its runner credential can look busy forever; the allocator only flags it. Decide a cap before the Windows profile serves public repos (open gap in P10).
In even mode, raising a runner count drains every admitted runner (legacy manager stop/start each time). Accept that or choose a smoother rule.
